GRANTING PERMISSION BY VIRTUE OF POWERS VESTED IN ME UNDER SECTION 27(A) OF PROVINCIAL
COUNCIL ACT, No. 42 OF 1987 AS THE TERM OF THE SABARAGAMUWA PROVINCIAL COUNCIL OF THE
DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA ENDED ON 26TH SEPTEMBER, 2017
1. This permission may be cited as ‘‘Permission to disburse under the First supplementary Financial Statement - 2025 of
the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council” and come in to operation from 04.04.2025.
2. The expenditure of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council which is estimated Rupees Sixty One Billion Seven Hundred

Thirty Eight Million One Hundred Thirty Eight Thousand only (Rs. 61,738,138,000.00) for the service of the period beginning on 01st of January, 2025 and ending 31st December 2025, which is specified as ‘‘Financial Year 2025” in the Annual Financial Statement and Revenue - Expenditure Estimates prepared for the year 2025, is hereby amended as, Rupees Sixty Two Billion Two Hundred Eight Million Fifty Five Thousand Eighty Two and Twelve Cents only (Rs.62,208,055,082.12) and grant permission to the Chief Secretary of this Province and other Accounting Officers to disburse the same from the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council Fund.
3. Accordingly the first schedule of the Annual Financial Statement and revenue- expenditure estimates - 2025, is amended
as the first schedule hereof and grant permission to disburse the same.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk

A.A.C.J. Rajarathna, Governor, Sabaragamuwa Province. 04th day of April, 2025.

I do hereby grant permission to the Chief Secretary and the Accounting Officers of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council to disburse as per the First Supplementary Financial Statement for the year 2025, by virtue of powers vested in me under Section 27 (a) of the Provincial Council Act No. 42 of 1987, as the term of the 06th Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka ended on 26th September, 2017.

I do hereby grant permission to the Chief Secratary and the Accounting Officers of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council to spend a sum of Sixty Two Billion Two Hundred Eight Million Fifty Five Thousand Eighty Two and Twelve Cents only (Rs. 62,208,055,082.12) out of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council Fund, which is estimated for the expenses of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council for the one year period that starts on 01st of January, 2025 and end on 31st of December, 2025.

This permission will be valid till 31st of December, 2025 or upto the date that expires three months (03) from the date of summoning the Seventh (07th) Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council or from the date re-start the functions of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council which occurs first. A.A.C.J. Rajarathna, Hon. Governor, Sabaragamuwa Province. 04th day of April, 2025.

I do hereby approve to amend the advance account limits for the year 2024 stated in the Sixth Schedule of the First Supplementary Financial Statement for the year 2025, by virtue of powers vested in me under Section 27 (a) of the Provincial Council Act, No. 42 of 1987, as the term of the 06th Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka ended on 26th September, 2017.
Accordingly, I do hereby grant permission to the Chief Secretary and the Accounting Officers of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council to bear the expenses subject to those limits.
A.A.C.J. Rajarathna, Governor, Sabaragamuwa Province. 04th day of April, 2025.
